Package controller

Class ClientController

java.lang.Object
controller.ClientController
public class ClientController extends Object
Main Controller of the project, housing the userList and clientView for the project, and passing information between the two.
Author:
Nolan Wright

  • Method Details

    • initialize

      public void initialize()
      Initializes the Program, via collecting the file location from ClientView, loading the data, and then starting the ClientView. Along with this it starts all the internal schedulers for autosave, time tracking, and starts the display for logged in users.

    • saveData

      public void saveData(int finalSave)
      Saves the UserList to a file (same file that was given at startUp)
      Parameters:
      finalSave - If a 1 is given to the saveData program, UserList will be instructed to logout all users before saving.

    • searchForUsers

      public UserData[] searchForUsers(String userName, String userEmail, String userPhoneNumber)
      Used to Search through the UserList via a LevenshteinDistance Equation
      Parameters:
      userName - The given User Name (if available)
      userEmail - The given User Email (if available)
      userPhoneNumber - The given User Phone Number (if available)
      Returns:
      Returns a list of up to 5 users with the closest distance from the equation
